label: Wire skill/agent frontmatter validation into the existing guards pipeline
summary: Chose `skillcheck` (uvx) as the frontmatter validator, proved it red/green on the 1ceffdbf pre-fix bytes, and wired it as a Tier 1 guard (tools/guards-manifest.mjs) that runs on every commit touching extensions/skills/**/SKILL.md or extensions/agents/**/*.md.

changes.kind: new guard script — runs `uvx skillcheck` over exactly the changed SKILL.md files (--skip-ref-check), fail-closed if uvx absent
registered `skill-frontmatter` Tier 1 guard watching extensions/skills/ + extensions/agents/; Tier-1 count comment 34 -> 35

issues: 3 skills carry no YAML frontmatter at all (di-codex-skill, di-skill, sox-ingest) — skillcheck reports frontmatter.name.required / description.required. Same silent-drop class as 1ceffdbf. NOT fixed (out of scope); filed as backlog 935af7ff-f1b8-47e9-b699-ab5fd8caf1fa.

Agent source .md files in this repo are prose-only (frontmatter rendered from extension.json by libs/host-registry/src/agent-renderers.ts via yamlStringify at install). cclint (the research's agent-side candidate) targets Claude Code .claude/agents/*.md subagent files, a layout absent here, and finds 0 files against extensions/agents/. So the agent leg is a structural no-op today; the watch still arms extensions/agents/ for the future.

CI (ci.yml guards-tier1 --all) runs the guard with no staged diff, so it no-ops there; primary enforcement is the pre-commit hook. A full-sweep `--all` on the guard script would red-bar on the 3 missing-frontmatter skills, which is why the guard lints changed files only.
handoff_notes: Exact wiring: .husky/pre-commit -> node tools/run-guards.mjs --tier1 -> guards-manifest.mjs entry `skill-frontmatter` -> tools/check-skill-frontmatter.mjs -> uvx skillcheck <changed SKILL.md> --skip-ref-check
Manual full-audit command: uvx skillcheck extensions/skills --skip-ref-check (flags the 3 missing-frontmatter skills + would flag ref issues without --skip-ref-check)
uv is a runtime prerequisite for the guard on machines that commit SKILL.md changes (fail-closed message if absent)
